courses.title: Share Market Mastery
courses.description: The complete basic-to-advanced course on Indian markets (NSE/BSE): foundations, chart reading, market reading, risk management, strategies, F&O, and psychology.

courses.title: Graph Reading & Market Reading — Field Guide
courses.description: A practical field guide in two parts: reading a single chart (candles, levels, patterns, volume, timeframes) and reading the whole market (breadth, flows, sectors, macro, sentiment).

courses.title: .NET Framework
courses.description: The classic Windows .NET platform: CLR internals, C# essentials, memory & GC, ASP.NET MVC and ADO.NET/EF6 — plus a full interview preparation module.

courses.title: .NET Core / Modern .NET
courses.description: Cross-platform modern .NET: ASP.NET Core pipeline, dependency injection, EF Core, async, hosting and deployment — plus interview Q&A from basics to architecture.

courses.title: React
courses.description: Component thinking, hooks, state management, data fetching, performance patterns — plus the interview questions React developers actually get asked.

courses.title: Angular
courses.description: Components, DI, RxJS, routing, forms and change detection in the batteries-included framework — plus a complete interview prep module.

courses.title: SQL Server
courses.description: From tables and joins to indexes, execution plans, transactions and stored procedures — plus the T-SQL interview questions that appear in every round.
